name: fibroblast growth factor receptor 3
pathways: positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction

function.text: FGFR3 encodes fibroblast growth factor receptor 3. Annotated molecular activities include protein tyrosine kinase activity and fibroblast growth factor receptor activity. It participates in positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction and positive regulation of phospholipase activity.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Crouzon syndrome-acanthosis nigricans syndrome (autosomal dominant); Muenke syndrome (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Plasma cell myeloma; Spermatocytic tumor; Urothelial carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: FGFR3 encodes fibroblast growth factor receptor 3. It participates in positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction and positive regulation of phospholipase activity. Functional annotations also associate the protein with protein tyrosine kinase activity and fibroblast growth factor receptor activity.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Crouzon syndrome-acanthosis nigricans syndrome (autosomal dominant); Muenke syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving FGFR3 have been reported in plasma cell myeloma, spermatocytic tumor, and urothelial carcinoma.
